description:
The Huffy Disney Princess Tricycle brings storybook magic to every ride with beautiful Disney Princess graphics and charming pink and purple styling. Designed for kids ages 3 and up, this kids tricycle inspires imaginative outdoor adventures and everyday fun.
A stable three-wheel design and comfortable bucket seat help young riders build confidence as they learn to pedal and steer. The durable steel frame is built for everyday adventures, while the easy-to-grip seat handle adds extra comfort and security.
A convenient rear storage bin lets little riders bring along favorite toys and treasures wherever they go. Whether exploring the neighborhood or creating magical adventures, this Disney Princess tricycle is made for fun that grows with every ride.
